title: Uniform-in-Time Weak Propagation-of-Chaos in Shallow Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.22010v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider one-hidden layer neural networks trained in the feature-learning regime using gradient descent, and relate the output of the finite-width network $f_{\hat{\rho}_t^m}$ to its infinite-width counterpart $f_{\rho_t^{MF}}$, which evolves in the mean-field dynamics.   While constant-time horizon bounds for $\|f_{\rho_t^{MF}} - f_{\hat{\rho}_t^m}\|$ may be obtained via standard Gr\"onwall estimates, the long-time behavior of the fluctuation is a more delicate matter. Uniform-in-time bounds often rely on (local) strong convexity in the landscape or Logarithmic Sobolev inequalities present in noisy gradient dynamics.   In this work, we establish non-asymptotic weak propagation-of-chaos that holds uniformly in time, obtained by exploiting instead the convergence rate of the mean-field deterministic Wasserstein-gradient-flow dynamics. translated_title: 浅层神经网络中随时间一致的弱混沌传播
translated_abstract: 我们考虑在特征学习机制下使用梯度下降训练的单隐层神经网络，并将有限宽度网络的输出 $f_{\hat{\rho}_t^m}$ 与其无穷宽度对应物 $f_{\rho_t^{MF}}$（按平均场动力学演化）建立联系。虽然可以通过标准的 Grönwall 估计得到 $\|f_{\rho_t^{MF}} - f_{\hat{\rho}_t^m}\|$ 在常数时间范围内的界，但波动的长时间行为是一个更为微妙的问题。随时间一致的界通常依赖于损失景观中的（局部）强凸性，或带噪梯度动力学中存在的对数 Sobolev 不等式。在这项工作中，我们建立了随时间一致成立的非渐近弱混沌传播，这是通过利用平均场确定性 Wasserstein 梯度流动动力学的收敛速率而实现的。具体而言，记 $L_t$ 为时刻 $t$ 的平均场超额 MSE 损失，$m$ 为神经元数量……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过利用平均场确定性 Wasserstein 梯度流动的收敛速率，而非依赖强凸性或对数 Sobolev 不等式，首次在浅层神经网络的梯度下降训练中建立了随时间一致成立的非渐近弱混沌传播结果。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes non-asymptotic weak propagation of chaos that holds uniformly in time for shallow neural networks trained by gradient descent, by exploiting the convergence rate of the mean-field deterministic Wasserstein gradient-flow dynamics rather than relying on strong convexity or logarithmic Sobolev inequalities.
